Galileo improved the lenses of his telescope himself.
伽利略亲自改进了他的望远镜镜片。
a weight that swings from side to side, used in clocks
The pendulum clock was far more accurate than earlier clocks.
摆钟比更早的钟准确得多。
an explosive powder used in guns and fireworks
Gunpowder was invented by Chinese alchemists more than a thousand years ago.
火药是一千多年前由中国的炼丹家发明的。
a machine with a large wheel used to make thread
The spinning wheel made it much faster to produce thread.
纺车大大加快了纺线的速度。
Power looms put many hand weavers out of work.
动力织布机让许多手工织工失业了。
a very hot oven for baking pottery or bricks
Chinese kilns could reach temperatures above 1,200°C.
中国的窑能达到 1200 摄氏度以上的高温。
to heat rock to get metal from it
People learned to smelt iron more than 3,000 years ago.
人类在三千多年前就学会了冶铁。

volumes.name: 商业与经济
words: a business or company; the ability to think of new projects
The government offers loans to small enterprises.
政府向小企业提供贷款。
a business or company; strong and not likely to change
She works for a law firm in London.
她在伦敦的一家律师事务所工作。
Multinational companies can move production to wherever costs are lowest.
跨国公司可以把生产转移到成本最低的地方。
Many start-ups fail within their first five years.
许多初创公司会在头五年内倒闭。
the main office of a company or organisation
The company moved its headquarters from London to Dublin.
这家公司把总部从伦敦搬到了都柏林。
the joining together of two companies
The merger created the largest bank in Europe.
这次合并造就了欧洲最大的银行。
gaining control of a company by buying most of its shares
The board rejected a takeover bid from a rival firm.
董事会拒绝了一家竞争对手公司的收购要约。
a person who owns shares in a company
Shareholders voted against the chief executive's pay rise.
股东们投票反对给首席执行官加薪。
a person or group affected by what a company or project does
Local residents are important stakeholders in the airport plan.
当地居民是机场规划中的重要利益相关者。
the person with the highest rank in a company
The chief executive resigned after the scandal.
丑闻之后，首席执行官辞职了。
the control of a business; the people who run it
Poor management led to the collapse of the company.
管理不善导致了这家公司的倒闭。
to pay another company to do work that your company used to do
Many banks outsource their customer service to other countries.
许多银行把客户服务外包到其他国家。
to reduce the number of people working in a company
The factory downsized from 800 workers to 300.
这家工厂把工人从 800 人裁减到 300 人。
The airline went bankrupt after fuel prices soared.
燃油价格飙升后，这家航空公司破产了。
the total value of a company's sales; the rate at which staff leave
The company has an annual turnover of £5 million.
这家公司的年营业额为 500 万英镑。
the regular costs of running a business, such as rent and electricity
Working from home helps companies cut their overheads.
居家办公帮助公司削减了经常性开支。
money gained after all costs have been paid
The company made a profit for the first time in five years.
这家公司五年来首次盈利。
losing money rather than making a profit
The loss-making shops will be closed next year.
这些亏损的店铺明年将关闭。
the right to sell a company's products in an area using its name
He bought a coffee shop franchise in his home town.
他在家乡买下了一家咖啡店的加盟经营权。
a company with few employees and a small turnover
Small businesses were hit hardest by the rise in energy prices.
能源价格上涨对小企业的打击最大。
the organisation of moving goods, people or supplies
Online shopping depends on fast and cheap logistics.
网购依赖快速而廉价的物流。
the department of a company that deals with employing and training staff
Contact human resources if you have questions about your contract.
如果你对合同有疑问，请联系人力资源部。
the part of all sales in a market that one company has
The firm's market share fell from 30 to 18 per cent.
这家公司的市场份额从 30% 降到了 18%。
the amount of goods available and the amount people want to buy
Prices are set by supply and demand.
价格是由供求关系决定的。
a person or company trying to win or sell more than others
Cheaper competitors have taken many of our customers.
更便宜的竞争对手抢走了我们很多客户。
complete control of a market by one company
The railway company had a monopoly on long-distance travel.
这家铁路公司垄断了长途客运。
a type of product made by a particular company
Young consumers are less loyal to brands than their parents were.
年轻消费者对品牌的忠诚度不如他们的父母。
a design used by a company to identify its products
The company's logo is recognised all over the world.
这家公司的标识在全世界都能被认出来。
the business of advertising and selling products
The company spent more on marketing than on research.
这家公司在营销上的花费比研发还多。
a planned series of activities to achieve something
The anti-smoking campaign was aimed at teenagers.
这场禁烟宣传活动是针对青少年的。
to say publicly that you support a product or idea
Famous athletes are paid millions to endorse sports shoes.
著名运动员代言运动鞋能拿到数百万的报酬。
a company that pays for an event in return for advertising
The festival is sponsored by a local bank.
这个节日由当地一家银行赞助。
a small group of customers with special needs
Organic baby food was once a niche market.
有机婴儿食品曾经是一个小众市场。
a group of people, for example by age or income; connected with population
The advert targets a young, urban demographic.
这则广告瞄准的是年轻的城市人群。
collecting information about what people want to buy
Market research showed that customers wanted smaller packs.
市场调研显示，顾客想要更小的包装。
information passed on by people talking to each other
The restaurant became popular by word of mouth.
这家餐馆靠口碑火了起来。
buying and selling goods on the internet
E-commerce now accounts for over a quarter of retail sales in the UK.
电子商务如今在英国零售额中占四分之一以上。
a situation in which companies keep lowering prices to win customers
A price war between supermarkets kept food prices low.
超市之间的价格战使食品价格保持在低位。
of high quality and expensive; an extra amount paid
Customers will pay a premium for locally grown food.
顾客愿意为本地种植的食物多付钱。
something expensive that you enjoy but do not need
Sales of luxury goods have risen in Asia.
奢侈品在亚洲的销量上升了。
made to look exactly like something real in order to deceive
Customs officers seized thousands of counterfeit watches.
海关官员查获了数千块假冒手表。
a sudden increase in trade or activity
The housing boom ended suddenly in 2008.
住房繁荣在 2008 年戛然而止。
a sudden fall in prices, sales or activity
Car sales slumped during the recession.
经济衰退期间汽车销量暴跌。
the place or system where shares in companies are bought and sold
The stock market fell sharply after the announcement.
消息公布后，股市大幅下跌。
one of the equal parts into which a company's value is divided
She bought shares in a technology company.
她买了一家科技公司的股票。
a part of a company's profit paid to shareholders
The company paid a dividend of 5p per share.
这家公司每股派发了 5 便士的股息。
the percentage charged for borrowing money or paid on savings
The central bank raised interest rates to control inflation.
央行提高利率以控制通货膨胀。
money that someone borrows and must pay back
She took out a loan to pay for university.
她贷款来支付大学费用。
a loan used to buy a house
They will pay off their mortgage in 25 years.
他们将在 25 年内还清房贷。
Many students leave university with large debts.
许多学生大学毕业时背着巨额债务。
something valuable that a person or company owns
The company's assets include land and buildings.
这家公司的资产包括土地和建筑。
money a company owes; legal responsibility
The bank's liabilities were greater than its assets.
这家银行的负债超过了资产。
money used to start or grow a business
They needed more capital to open a second shop.
他们需要更多资本来开第二家店。
a tax on goods coming into a country
New tariffs made imported steel more expensive.
新的关税使进口钢材变得更贵。
goods brought into a country from abroad; to bring goods in
Japan imports most of its energy.
日本的大部分能源依靠进口。
trade between countries without taxes or limits
The free trade agreement removed tariffs on most goods.
自由贸易协定取消了大部分商品的关税。
the value of one currency compared with another
A weak exchange rate makes exports cheaper.
汇率走弱会让出口商品更便宜。
gross domestic product: the total value of goods and services a country produces in a year
China's GDP has grown rapidly since the 1980s.
自 20 世纪 80 年代以来，中国的国内生产总值增长迅速。
the amount by which spending is greater than income
The government plans to cut the budget deficit.
政府计划削减预算赤字。
a period of sharp cuts in government spending
Years of austerity led to cuts in public services.
多年的紧缩导致公共服务被削减。
buying things in the hope of selling them at a higher price; guessing
Speculation pushed house prices to record levels.
投机行为把房价推到了创纪录的水平。
an agreement to pay money regularly so that you are paid if something bad happens
Travel insurance covers you if your flight is cancelled.
航班取消时，旅游保险会给你赔付。
an act of buying or selling something
Most transactions in Sweden are now made without cash.
在瑞典，现在大多数交易都不用现金。

volumes.name: 城市与建筑
words: the art of designing buildings; the style of buildings
The city is famous for its Art Nouveau architecture.
这座城市以新艺术运动风格的建筑闻名。
Only the old facade was kept; the rest of the building was new.
只保留了旧的建筑正面，其余部分都是新建的。
The hotel is a twelve-storey building near the station.
这家酒店是车站附近一栋十二层的建筑。
a round roof shaped like half a ball
The dome of the Pantheon in Rome is still the largest unreinforced concrete dome in the world.
罗马万神殿的穹顶至今仍是世界上最大的无钢筋混凝土穹顶。
a curved structure over a door, window or bridge
The Romans used arches to build bridges that still stand today.
古罗马人用拱建造的桥梁至今依然屹立。
a tall stone post that supports a roof; a regular article in a newspaper
Greek temples were surrounded by rows of columns.
希腊神庙四周环绕着一排排柱子。
a building or place that is easy to recognise
The tower has become the city's best-known landmark.
这座塔已成为这座城市最著名的地标。
connected with beauty; a set of ideas about style
The building is practical, but it has little aesthetic appeal.
这栋建筑很实用，但没什么美感。
The palace has ornate ceilings painted with gold.
这座宫殿有饰以金箔的华丽天花板。
having two halves that are exactly the same
古典建筑通常是对称的。
to repair an old building so that it is in good condition again
The old station was renovated and turned into a museum.
这座旧车站经过翻修，改成了博物馆。
to knock down a building completely
The factory was demolished to make room for flats.
工厂被拆除，腾出地方建公寓。
knock down, pull down, tear down
a drawing that shows the layout of the rooms in a building
An open floor plan makes a small flat feel larger.
开放式的布局让小公寓显得更大。
The interior of the church is surprisingly plain.
这座教堂的内部出人意料地朴素。
The exterior walls are covered in glass.
The new flats are bright and spacious.
High-rise flats were built quickly in the 1960s.
20 世纪 60 年代高层公寓被迅速建起来。
Green roofs help to keep buildings cool in summer.
绿色屋顶有助于在夏天保持建筑凉爽。
a building that is protected by law because of its historical value
You cannot change the windows of a listed building without permission.
未经许可，不能改动受保护建筑的窗户。
an open space surrounded by walls or buildings
Traditional Beijing houses are built around a courtyard.
传统的北京民居围绕着一个庭院而建。
a frame of metal poles and boards used by builders working on a building
The cathedral was covered in scaffolding for years.
这座大教堂被脚手架包围了好多年。
made in parts in a factory and put together on site
Prefabricated homes can be built in a few weeks.
预制房屋几周内就能建好。
the design and control of how a town or city develops
Good urban planning puts schools and shops within walking distance.
好的城市规划会让学校和商店都在步行距离之内。
dividing a city into areas for different uses, such as housing or industry
Strict zoning laws keep factories away from homes.
严格的分区法规让工厂远离住宅。
an area of a town or country
The financial district is empty at weekends.
金融区在周末空荡荡的。
the parts of a town furthest from the centre
The new hospital will be built on the outskirts of the city.
新医院将建在城市的郊区。
the area near the centre of a city, often with social problems
The scheme aims to bring jobs to the inner city.
这项计划旨在为内城区带来就业。
a very large and important city
The small fishing village grew into a metropolis of 20 million people.
这个小渔村发展成了拥有两千万人口的大都市。
connected with the government of a town or city
The municipal library is open seven days a week.
市立图书馆每周开放七天。
a group of people elected to manage a town or area
The council voted to ban cars from the old town.
市政会投票决定禁止汽车进入老城区。
无车的；禁止汽车通行的
The city centre becomes car-free every Sunday.
每周日市中心禁止汽车通行。
a part of a road for bicycles only
New cycle lanes have doubled the number of cyclists.
新的自行车道使骑车人数翻了一番。
a road built around a town to keep traffic out of the centre
Lorries must use the ring road instead of driving through the town.
大货车必须走环路，不能穿城而过。
a road that goes around a town; to avoid something
The new bypass has cut traffic in the village by half.
新的绕行公路使村里的车流量减少了一半。
the time of day when most people travel to or from work
Trains are packed during the morning rush hour.
早高峰时段火车上挤满了人。
a situation in which traffic cannot move at all
An accident on the bridge caused gridlock across the city.
桥上的一起事故导致全城交通瘫痪。
a city that uses data and technology to run services such as transport and energy
In a smart city, traffic lights change according to real-time traffic.
在智慧城市里，红绿灯会根据实时交通情况变化。
describing land that has been built on before, especially by industry
Building on brownfield sites protects the countryside.
在工业废弃地上建房可以保护乡村。
an area of countryside around a city where building is limited
The green belt stops London from spreading further.
绿化带阻止伦敦进一步扩张。
empty and in poor condition because nobody has used it for a long time
Artists turned the derelict warehouse into studios.
艺术家们把废弃的仓库改成了工作室。
the process by which a poor area becomes richer, often forcing out the people who lived there
Gentrification has pushed rents beyond the reach of local families.
中产阶级化把房租推高到当地家庭难以承受的水平。
a large area where several towns have grown together
Greater Manchester is a conurbation of ten boroughs.
大曼彻斯特是由十个自治市组成的城市群。
having a lot of people living in a small area
Hong Kong is one of the most densely populated places on Earth.
香港是地球上人口最稠密的地方之一。
houses and flats for people to live in
The city needs 50,000 new homes to meet the demand for housing.
这座城市需要五万套新房来满足住房需求。
a person who owns their home
Fewer young people are becoming homeowners.
成为房主的年轻人越来越少了。
homes provided at low rent by the government or a charity
The waiting list for social housing is over ten years long.
保障性住房的轮候名单长达十年以上。
a building and its land; things that someone owns
Property prices in the capital have doubled in ten years.
首都的房价十年间翻了一番。
property in the form of land or buildings
Foreign investors are buying real estate in the city centre.
外国投资者正在市中心购买房地产。
The charity provides beds for homeless people in winter.
这家慈善机构冬天为无家可归者提供床位。

Around a billion people live in urban slums.
大约十亿人生活在城市贫民窟里。
an area where poor people live in huts made from waste materials
Shanty towns grew quickly on the edge of the capital.
棚户区在首都边缘迅速扩张。
an area of a town and the people who live there
It is a quiet neighbourhood with good schools.
这是一个有好学校的安静街区。
a house or flat where people live
The census counts every occupied dwelling in the country.
人口普查统计了全国每一处有人居住的住所。
a house that is not joined to any other house
Detached houses on the edge of town have large gardens.
城镇边缘的独立式住宅都有大花园。
one of a row of houses joined together
Victorian terraced houses were built for factory workers.
维多利亚时期的联排房屋是为工厂工人建造的。
a large building divided into flats
The new apartment block has a gym on the top floor.
新公寓楼的顶层有一个健身房。
Thousands of homes stand vacant while people wait for housing.
数以千计的住房空置着，而人们还在等房住。
forcing someone to leave their home by law
Tenants who fall behind with rent face eviction.
拖欠房租的租户面临被驱逐。
the amount of money a house costs to buy
House prices have risen much faster than wages.
房价上涨的速度远远快于工资。
too small for the people or things in it
Families of five live in cramped two-room flats.
五口之家住在狭窄的两居室公寓里。
shared by a group of people
Residents share a communal garden and laundry.
住户们共用一个花园和洗衣房。
the organisation that runs services in an area, such as schools and rubbish collection
The local authority is responsible for collecting rubbish.
地方政府负责收运垃圾。
the lights along the sides of streets
Better street lighting can make people feel safer at night.
更好的街道照明能让人们夜里感觉更安全。

volumes.name: 住宿与租房
words: a place to live or stay
The university helps first-year students find accommodation.
大学帮助一年级新生找住处。
a set of rooms for living in, on one floor of a building
She rents a two-bedroom flat near the station.
她在车站附近租了一套两居室的公寓。
a flat, especially a large or expensive one
The apartment comes with a parking space.
这套公寓带一个停车位。
a small flat with one main room for living and sleeping
A studio flat in the city centre costs about £900 a month.
市中心的单间公寓每月大约 900 英镑。
卧室兼起居室的出租房
a rented room used for both living and sleeping
As a student, he lived in a bedsit with a tiny kitchen.
上学时，他住在一间带小厨房的单间出租屋里。
半独立式的（与另一栋共用一面墙）
joined to another house on one side
They live in a semi-detached house with a small garden.
他们住在一栋带小花园的半独立式房子里。
a house with only one floor
Many retired couples move to a bungalow so they can avoid stairs.
许多退休夫妇搬进平房，这样就不用爬楼梯了。
a small house, usually in the countryside
We rented a cottage by the sea for a week.
我们在海边租了一周的小屋。
Most first-year students live in halls of residence.
大多数一年级学生住在学生宿舍楼里。
an arrangement in which a student lives with a local family
A homestay is a good way to practise speaking every day.
住寄宿家庭是每天练口语的好办法。
a cheap place to stay, often with shared rooms
The youth hostel has beds from £20 a night.
这家青年旅舍每晚 20 英镑起。
a large room or building where several people sleep
The hostel has a dormitory with eight beds.
这家旅舍有一间八张床的集体宿舍。
a house in which several people rent rooms and share the kitchen
In a shared house, everyone takes turns to clean the kitchen.
在合租房里，大家轮流打扫厨房。
a room or floor below ground level
The basement flat is cheaper but quite dark.
地下室的房子便宜些，但很暗。
a room in the roof of a house
We use the attic to store old furniture.
我们用阁楼来放旧家具。
the floor of a building at the same level as the street
The kitchen and living room are on the ground floor.
a platform on the outside of a building with a wall or rail around it
The bedroom has a small balcony overlooking the park.
卧室有一个俯瞰公园的小阳台。
a building for keeping a car in
The house has a garage and space for two cars.
这房子有一个车库，还能停两辆车。
a private road leading to a house
You can park on the driveway.
你可以把车停在车道上。
An en suite room costs £15 more per week.
带独立卫浴的房间每周贵 15 英镑。
a room in a house for the washing machine and other equipment
The washing machine is in the utility room next to the kitchen.
洗衣机在厨房旁边的杂物间里。
a room for washing clothes; clothes that need washing
There is a laundry on the ground floor with coin-operated machines.
一楼有一间投币洗衣房。
（与房屋相连的）玻璃暖房；音乐学院
a room with glass walls and roof, attached to a house
We have breakfast in the conservatory on sunny mornings.
晴朗的早上我们在玻璃暖房里吃早餐。
an open space in a wall where a fire can burn
The living room has an old stone fireplace.
客厅里有一个古老的石砌壁炉。
the area just inside the front door of a house
Please leave your shoes in the hallway.
a person who rents out a house or room
The landlord agreed to fix the heating by Friday.
房东同意在周五前修好暖气。
a woman who rents out a house or room
a person who pays rent to live in a house or flat
Tenants must give one month's notice before leaving.
租户退租前必须提前一个月通知。
a person who shares a flat with you
I'm looking for a flatmate to share the rent.
我在找一个室友分摊房租。
寄宿者（住在房东家里的租客）
a person who pays to live in part of someone else's home
They took in a lodger to help pay the mortgage.
他们招了一个房客来帮忙还房贷。
money paid regularly to use a house or room; to pay for this
The rent is £650 a month, including bills.
房租每月 650 英镑，含各项账单。
a legal agreement to rent property for a fixed period
We signed a one-year lease on the flat.
我们签了一年的公寓租约。
a written contract between a landlord and a tenant
Read the tenancy agreement carefully before you sign it.
签租房合同之前要仔细阅读。
a person or company that sells or rents out houses for owners
The estate agent showed us three flats in one afternoon.
房产中介一个下午带我们看了三套公寓。
a company that finds tenants and manages rented homes for landlords

to refuse to buy something as a protest
Some shoppers boycott brands that use child labour.
一些顾客抵制使用童工的品牌。
cheap clothes made quickly to follow new trends
Fast fashion produces huge amounts of textile waste.
快时尚产生了大量的纺织废物。
the environmental cost of fast fashion
made to be strong and to work for a long time
Older appliances were built to last.
designing products so that they stop working or become out of date quickly
Planned obsolescence forces people to replace phones every few years.
计划性淘汰迫使人们每隔几年就换手机。
the main street of a town, with many shops
Many high street shops have closed because of online shopping.
许多商业街的商店因为网购而关门。
Sweden is moving towards a cashless society.
瑞典正在走向无现金社会。
the way a person usually spends money
The pandemic changed people's spending habits.
疫情改变了人们的消费习惯。
a picture, short film or text that tries to sell something
Children see thousands of adverts every year, on TV and online.
孩子们每年在电视上和网上看到成千上万条广告。

volumes.name: 口语：观点与回应
words: used to give your own opinion, often one that others may not share
If you ask me, people spend far too much time on their phones.
要我说，人们花在手机上的时间太多了。
放在句首引出个人看法，比 I think 更口语、更有态度，后面直接接观点。
used to say what your own opinion is
As far as I'm concerned, a good teacher matters more than a famous school.
在我看来，好老师比名校更重要。
强调“这只是我的看法”；不要说成 as far as I concern。
used to give an opinion or a guess in a polite way
I'd say most people in my city cycle to work.
我觉得我们城市大多数人骑车上班。
语气柔和，适合回答估计和比较类问题：I'd say about half…
To my mind, the best way to learn a language is to live abroad.
在我看来，学语言最好的办法是出国生活。
in my opinion, in my view
可以和 in my opinion 换着用，避免一直说 I think。
used to show that you are giving your own opinion
Personally speaking, I prefer reading on paper rather than on a screen.
就我个人而言，我更喜欢读纸质书，而不是看屏幕。
句首用，常和 prefer、would rather 搭配；也可以只说 Personally, …
someone who likes something or someone very much
I'm a big fan of Italian food, especially fresh pasta.
我特别喜欢意大利菜，尤其是新鲜意面。
I'm a big fan of + 名词/doing；否定 I'm not a big fan of… 比 I don't like 委婉。
liking something or wanting to do something
I'm not very keen on horror films.
be keen on + 名词/doing（不接 to do）；英式口语常用否定 not very keen on。
to dislike someone or something very much
I can't stand waiting in long queues.
can't stand + 名词/doing；语气比 don't like 强得多。
not something that I like or am interested in
Opera is not really my cup of tea.
委婉地说不喜欢，几乎只用否定。
used to say what you would prefer to do
I'd rather stay at home than go to a noisy club.
我宁愿待在家里，也不想去吵闹的夜店。
I'd rather + 动词原形 (than + 动词原形)；不加 to：I'd rather go，不说 I'd rather to go。
strongly supporting an idea or plan
I'm all for having more cycle lanes in the city.
我完全赞成城市里多建自行车道。
be all for + 名词/doing，口语里表示强烈支持。
I'm in two minds about whether to study abroad.
我还拿不定主意要不要出国读书。
be in two minds about + 名词/whether…；适合表示两边都有道理，再分别展开。
used to say that you have noticed or realised something
It strikes me that young people today are under a lot of pressure.
我觉得如今的年轻人压力很大。
比 I think 多一层“我观察到”的意味，Part 3 谈社会现象时好用。
I reckon more people will work from home in the future.
我估计将来会有更多人在家办公。
英式口语，比 I think 随意，后面直接接句子。
used when adding something that makes a criticism seem less strong
The food was expensive, but to be fair, the portions were huge.
菜很贵，不过说句公道话，分量很大。
批评之后补一句好话，显得观点平衡。
used to say that you agree completely
You think the city needs more parks? I couldn't agree more.
你觉得城市需要更多公园？我完全同意。
否定形式表示最强烈的同意，不是“不同意”。
used to say that something is obvious
It goes without saying that health is more important than money.
不用说，健康比金钱更重要。
It goes without saying that + 句子；不说 it goes without say。
a mixture of positive and negative feelings about something
I have mixed feelings about living in a big city.
对于住在大城市，我的心情很复杂。
have mixed feelings about + 名词/doing，接着讲好处和坏处，正好展开回答。
not very interested in something or worried about it
I'm not that bothered about fashion.
英式口语：I'm not that bothered about…，回答“你喜欢……吗”时比 I don't care 礼貌。
used to say that people have different tastes and that this is fine
Some people love camping, but each to their own.
有些人很爱露营，不过人各有所好嘛。
表示尊重别人的喜好，常放句末。
used to give yourself time before answering
Let me think... I'd say my favourite season is autumn.
让我想想……我最喜欢的季节应该是秋天。
需要几秒钟思考时说，比沉默或 emm 好；但别每题都用。
used to give yourself time to think about a difficult question
That's a good question. I've never compared the two before.
这个问题问得好。我以前从没比较过这两者。
Part 3 遇到难题时争取时间；说完马上给出观点，不要停住。
I've never really thought about it
used when a question is new to you, before you give an answer
I've never really thought about it, but I suppose I'd like to live by the sea.
我从没真正想过，不过我想我会愿意住在海边。
坦白说没想过，然后马上给出答案（but I suppose…），考官完全能接受。
used when you cannot give a definite answer
It's hard to say which generation has an easier life.
很难说哪一代人的生活更轻松。
It's hard to say + 疑问词从句；之后要说出你的倾向：but I'd guess…
used to say that the answer changes with the situation
It depends on the weather, but I usually walk to work.
要看天气，不过我通常走路上班。
It depends on + 名词/疑问词从句；一定要接着说取决于什么，别只说 It depends。
I've more or less finished decorating my new flat.
我的新公寓差不多布置好了。
放在动词前或句末：It's more or less the same。
to some degree; used when something is not exactly true
I'm sort of interested in photography, but I'm not very good at it.
我对摄影有点儿兴趣，但拍得不太好。
让语气不那么绝对；kind of 意思一样。每段用一两次就够了。
used to say that you think something is probably true
I suppose most children prefer games to books.
我想大多数孩子更喜欢游戏而不是书。
语气比 I think 弱，表示不完全确定；也可以放句末：…, I suppose。
I think, but I am not sure
I guess I spend about two hours a day online.
我猜我每天上网大约两小时。
比较随意，美式更常用；正式一点可以换成 I'd imagine。
off the top of my head
Off the top of my head, I can think of three good restaurants nearby.
凭印象我能想到附近三家不错的餐馆。
说数字或例子前用，表示是临时想到的，不保证准确。
used to say that you think something is true but may not know everything
As far as I know, the museum is free on Sundays.
据我所知，博物馆周日免费。
说你不完全肯定的事实时用，后面接完整句子。
used when you are not completely sure your memory is correct
If I remember rightly, I was about ten when we moved house.
如果我没记错，我们搬家时我大约十岁。
讲过去的经历时很实用；也说 if I remember correctly。
used to give a careful guess
I'd imagine life in the countryside is much quieter.
我想乡下的生活要安静得多。
谈自己没经历过的事时用，比 I think 更谨慎得体。
used before saying what you really think
To be honest, I don't watch much television these days.
说实话，我这些天不怎么看电视。
说出真实想法前用；别每个回答都以它开头，否则像口头禅。
used to say what is true, especially when it is surprising or different
I actually enjoy cooking, even though I'm not very good at it.
其实我挺喜欢做饭的，虽然做得不太好。
意思是“其实”，不是“目前”（目前是 currently / at the moment）；常用来纠正或补充。
used when you are not exact about a detail
We stayed in a little hotel called Sea View or something like that.
我们住在一家叫“海景”之类名字的小旅馆。
记不清名字、数字时放句末；说数量大约也可以用 or so。
I'm not a hundred per cent sure, but I think it opened in 2015.
我不能百分之百肯定，不过我想它是 2015 年开的。
常用否定 I'm not a hundred per cent sure 表示有点不确定；英式写 per cent。
used when you are trying to find the right words
My hometown is, how can I put it, a bit old-fashioned.
我的家乡，怎么说呢，有点老派。
找词时自然地停顿，比 emm 好；插在句中，后面给出描述。
usually; in more than half of cases
More often than not, I have lunch at my desk.
我多半在办公桌前吃午饭。
代替 usually，让回答更有变化；放句首或句末。
used to say that something is true in most cases
Generally speaking, people in my country eat dinner quite late.
一般来说，我们国家的人晚饭吃得比较晚。
先概括、再说例外：Generally speaking…, but…，Part 3 很实用。
A good example would be my uncle, who changed careers at fifty.
一个很好的例子是我叔叔，他五十岁时转了行。
Part 3 举例时用，比反复说 for example 更自然，后面接名词。
used to explain something you have just said more clearly
What I mean is, people should be free to choose.
我的意思是，人们应该有选择的自由。
觉得没说清楚时补充解释；考官追问时也能用。
used to introduce a problem or an explanation
I'd love to travel more. The thing is, I don't have much free time.
我很想多出去旅行。问题是我没多少空闲时间。
引出原因或困难，口语里非常常用；后面常有停顿。
used to introduce the most important fact
The point is, children need time to play as well as study.
关键在于，孩子既要学习，也需要玩的时间。
把话题拉回重点；比 the thing is 更强调“最重要的”。
used to add something that makes what you have just said less strong
The hotel was lovely. Mind you, it was very expensive.
那家酒店很不错。不过价格也很贵。
英式口语，补充一个相反的细节，放句首。
used before saying something that contrasts with what you have just said
I love big cities. Having said that, I need a quiet weekend now and then.
我喜欢大城市。话虽如此，我偶尔也需要一个安静的周末。
口语里的让步转折，比 but 高级；前面先说完一个观点。
in addition to what has just been said
The flat is small, and on top of that, it's very noisy.
那套公寓很小，而且还很吵。
追加一个理由（常是坏处），比 and also 更有力。
used to add something that makes your point stronger
Cycling is cheap, not to mention good for your health.
骑车很便宜，更不用说对健康有好处。
接名词或 doing，用来补充最后一条有力的理由。
I like hiking, camping and stuff like that.
我喜欢徒步、露营之类的活动。
and so on, and things like that
非常口语的列举收尾；偶尔用可以，正式一点说 and things like that。
used to change the subject or return to the main point
Anyway, that's why I decided to learn English.
总之，这就是我决定学英语的原因。
讲完细节回到主线，或结束一个故事；不要写成 anyways。
used when something said makes you remember something
That reminds me, I need to call my grandmother this weekend.
这倒提醒了我，这周末我得给奶奶打电话。
自然地引出相关的话题或经历，讲故事时好用。
used to introduce a new topic connected with what has just been said
Speaking of which, a new library has just opened near my flat.
说到这个，我家附近刚开了一家新图书馆。
talking of which, that reminds me
顺着刚才的话题转到相关内容；也说 talking of which。
used when you have just remembered or realised something
Come to think of it, I haven't been to the cinema for months.
这么一想，我已经好几个月没去电影院了。
now that I think about it
说话时“突然想到”，让回答听起来自然真实。
used to say that something is surprising
Funnily enough, I met my best friend on a train.
说来也巧，我是在火车上认识我最好的朋友的。
引出一个出人意料的细节，讲经历时很生动。
used to say that something is true although it is surprising
Believe it or not, I've never learned to swim.
信不信由你，我从没学过游泳。
引出令人惊讶的事实，放句首。
to cut a long story short
used to get to the end of a story quickly
To cut a long story short, we missed the train and had to stay another night.
长话短说，我们没赶上火车，只好又住了一晚。
Part 2 时间快到时用来收尾，直接说结果。
used after a negative to say that a second thing is even less likely
I can't afford a car, let alone a house.
我连车都买不起，更别说房子了。
前面是否定句，后面接更不可能的事；和 not to mention 不同，它只用在否定之后。
used to give the first of several reasons
I'd never live in the city centre. For one thing, it's far too expensive.
我永远不会住在市中心。首先，那里太贵了。
给出第一个理由，后面可以接 for another (thing)…
at the end of the day
used to say what is most important after considering everything
At the end of the day, your health matters more than your job.
归根结底，健康比工作更重要。
ultimately, when all is said and done
Part 3 总结观点时用；字面意思“一天结束时”也常见，看上下文。
In a way, social media has made people lonelier.
在某种程度上，社交媒体让人更孤独了。
in some ways, to some extent
让观点不那么绝对；也说 in some ways。

volumes.name: 口语：描述人
words: 好看的；长得帅或漂亮的
My cousin is quite good-looking, and he knows it!
我表哥长得挺帅，而且他自己也知道！
男女都能用，比 beautiful / handsome 更日常。
unusual or attractive in a way that you notice
她有一双引人注目的绿眼睛。
形容外貌或景色“让人一眼注意到”；a striking resemblance 长得极像。
My grandfather was always well-dressed, even at home.
我爷爷总是穿得很讲究，在家也一样。
也说 smartly dressed；反义是 scruffy。
He usually looks a bit scruffy in his old jeans.
他穿着旧牛仔裤，通常显得有点邋遢。
形容人或衣服不整洁，英式口语常用。
My mother is tall and slim.
是夸奖；thin 有时偏“瘦弱”，skinny 更随意甚至带贬义。
My PE teacher was a tall, well-built man.
我的体育老师是个高大健壮的男人。
委婉地说身材壮；描述人时不要说 fat。
He's of medium height, with short dark hair.
他中等个子，留着黑色短发。
描述人的固定说法：be of medium height / medium build。
My aunt must be in her late twenties.
我阿姨应该快三十岁了。
in his/her/my + early/mid/late + twenties/thirties…，说年龄更地道。
描述头发：curly / wavy / straight；顺序是长度、形状、颜色。
My best friend has shoulder-length blonde hair.
我最好的朋友留着齐肩的金发。
描述头发长度：short / shoulder-length / long。
a friendly smile that makes people feel welcome
Our neighbour always greets us with a warm smile.
我们的邻居总是带着温暖的笑容和我们打招呼。
描述人时加上表情更生动：a warm / cheeky / shy smile。
I usually wear casual clothes at weekends.
casual clothes 休闲装；反义是 formal / smart。
to look or behave like an older relative
I take after my father; we're both very quiet.
我像我爸，我们俩都很安静。
只用于像父母等长辈亲人；不用进行时。
to be similar in appearance to someone
People say I look like my grandmother.
人们说我长得像我奶奶。
What does she look like? 问长相；What is she like? 问性格，别混淆。
My piano teacher was an elegant woman in her sixties.
我的钢琴老师是一位六十多岁的优雅女士。
形容人的气质、衣着或建筑，比 beautiful 更具体。
having darker skin after time in the sun
He came back from his holiday looking tanned and relaxed.
他度假回来，晒黑了，看起来很放松。
get a tan 晒黑；英式多用 tanned 作形容词。
lines on the skin that appear with age
My grandmother has lots of wrinkles, but her eyes are still bright.
我奶奶脸上有很多皱纹，但眼睛依然明亮。
常用复数；描述老人时可以说 a kind face with lots of wrinkles。
the ability to choose clothes that look good
My sister has great dress sense; she always looks stylish.
我姐姐穿衣品味很好，总是很有型。
have good / no dress sense，夸人会穿衣服的地道说法。
to be very easy to see or notice
With his bright red hair, he really stands out in a crowd.
他一头鲜红的头发，在人群里特别显眼。
stand out in a crowd / from the others；也可以指能力出众。
popular or stylish at a particular time
She always wears fashionable clothes, but never expensive ones.
她总穿时髦的衣服，但从不穿贵的。
形容衣服、人或地方；反义是 old-fashioned / out of fashion。
My dad is very easy-going; nothing seems to worry him.
我爸非常随和，好像什么事都不让他担心。
描述性格最常用的好词之一，比 nice 具体得多。
My sister is much more outgoing than me.
反义是 shy / reserved / introverted，描述朋友时常用。
Life in my hometown is quite laid-back.
我家乡的生活节奏很悠闲。
可以形容人，也可以形容地方或生活方式。
practical and sensible, without pretending to be important
Even though she's famous, she's very down-to-earth.
虽然她很有名，但为人很实在。
夸人朴实、不摆架子，谈名人话题很好用。
putting a lot of effort into work
My parents are both very hard-working people.
我父母都是非常勤劳的人。
放在名词前或 be 后：a hard-working student。
happy to give money, time or help
My grandmother is generous with her time and her cooking.
我奶奶很大方，舍得花时间，也乐意给大家做饭。
be generous with + 东西 / to + 人；反义是 mean / stingy。
thinking about other people's feelings and needs
She's very considerate and always remembers my birthday.
她很体贴，总记得我的生日。
和 considerable（相当大的）不同，别拼混。
not willing to change your mind
My uncle is so stubborn that he never admits he's wrong.
我叔叔太固执了，从来不承认自己错了。
一般是缺点；as stubborn as a mule 犟得像头骡子。
wanting very much to be successful
She's ambitious and wants to run her own company one day.
她很有抱负，想将来自己开公司。
中性偏褒；也可以形容计划：an ambitious plan。
My favourite teacher was witty and made every lesson fun.
我最喜欢的老师风趣机智，每节课都很有意思。
比 funny 高级，强调说话聪明有趣。
always telling other people what to do
My older sister was quite bossy when we were kids.
小时候我姐姐挺爱指挥人的。
口语里常见的贬义词，描述兄弟姐妹时很好用。
Public speaking made me more self-confident.
公开演讲让我更自信了。
也可以只说 confident；反义是 insecure。
not showing your feelings or opinions easily
He seems reserved at first, but he's very friendly once you know him.
他一开始显得很内敛，熟了以后其实很友好。
比 shy 更中性，指不轻易表露情感；也有“预订的”意思（a reserved seat）。
kind and thinking about others; thinking carefully
My friend sent me a thoughtful card when I was ill.
我生病时朋友给我寄了一张很贴心的卡片。
It was thoughtful of you to… 夸人体贴；也可以指“若有所思的”。
able to make good, practical decisions
My best friend is very sensible, so I always ask her for advice.
我最好的朋友很理智，所以我总找她出主意。
意思是“明智的”，不是“敏感的”（敏感是 sensitive），这是常见错误。
liking to talk a lot in a friendly way
Our taxi driver was very chatty and told us about the city.
出租车司机很健谈，给我们讲了这座城市的事。
非正式，带友好意味；talkative 是中性词。
someone who listens carefully and with sympathy
My mum is a good listener, so I tell her everything.
我妈妈很会倾听，所以我什么都跟她说。
描述朋友、家人时的好说法：She's a good listener。
calm and sensible, especially in difficult situations
She stays level-headed even in an emergency.
即使在紧急情况下她也能保持冷静。
夸人遇事冷静，Part 2 描述你钦佩的人时适用。
thinking you are more important or clever than you are
He became a bit big-headed after he won the prize.
他得奖之后有点自大了。
英式口语，贬义，比 arrogant 随意。
kind and generous to other people
My grandfather was a kind-hearted man who helped everyone.
我爷爷是个心地善良的人，谁都愿意帮。
比 kind 更有感情，描述长辈时常用。
to have a friendly relationship with someone
I get on really well with my flatmates.
我和室友相处得非常好。
get on (well) with sb，英式常用；美式多说 get along with。
I've always looked up to my older cousin.
我一直很敬佩我的表哥。
描述你钦佩的人（Part 2 高频）：I really look up to her because…
to trust someone to help or support you
I know I can rely on my parents when things go wrong.
我知道出了问题时可以依靠父母。
rely on sb (to do sth)；也可以说 rely on technology 依赖科技。
to argue with someone and stop being friendly
I fell out with my best friend over something silly.
我和最好的朋友为一件小事闹翻了。
fall out (with sb) (over sth)；和好是 make up。
We hit it off as soon as we met at university.
我们在大学一见面就很投缘。
讲怎么认识朋友时很地道：We hit it off straight away。
to continue to communicate with someone
We keep in touch through video calls.
我们通过视频通话保持联系。
keep in touch with sb；反义是 lose touch。
I lost touch with most of my school friends after we left school.
离开学校后，我和大部分同学都失去了联系。
lose touch with sb；也可以说 lose touch with reality 脱离现实。
a friend you know very well and like a lot
I have a few close friends rather than lots of casual ones.
我有几个知心朋友，而不是一大堆泛泛之交。
close 读 /kləʊs/（亲近的），不读 /kləʊz/（关闭）。
someone you know but not very well
He's not really a friend, more of an acquaintance.
他不算朋友，更像是个熟人。
区分 friend 和 acquaintance，谈社交圈时很有用。
a friend from when you were a child
My oldest childhood friend now lives in Canada.
我认识最久的发小现在住在加拿大。
Part 2 描述朋友时常用；也说 a friend from school。
to share many interests or qualities
We have a lot in common, especially our love of music.
我们有很多共同点，尤其是都热爱音乐。
have a lot / nothing / something in common (with sb)。
My father and I don't always see eye to eye on politics.
我和我爸在政治上意见并不总是一致。
多用否定：don't see eye to eye on / about sth。
to start to know someone better
It took me a while to get to know my new colleagues.
我花了一段时间才熟悉新同事。
get to know sb 强调慢慢熟悉的过程。
to slowly become less close to someone
We grew apart after she moved to another city.
她搬到别的城市后，我们渐渐疏远了。
没有吵架，只是自然疏远；和 fall out 不同。
to be sure that someone will help you
You can always count on her in a crisis.
危急时刻你总能指望她。
count on sb (to do sth)，比 rely on 更口语。
someone who listens and comforts you when you are sad
When I failed my exam, my sister was a shoulder to cry on.
我考试没过的时候，姐姐成了我倾诉的对象。
描述好朋友或家人的支持：She's always been a shoulder to cry on。
to continue to support someone in a difficult situation
My friends stood by me when I lost my job.
我失业时朋友们一直支持我。
stand by sb 支持某人；单用 stand by 还有“待命”的意思。
the group of people you are friends with
My circle of friends grew a lot when I started university.
上大学后，我的交际圈扩大了很多。
a wide / small circle of friends；不是微信“朋友圈”（那是 Moments）。
to start to talk about your feelings
It took him a long time to open up to me.
他过了很久才对我敞开心扉。
open up to sb (about sth)；也有“开放、开张”的意思。
to start a friendship with someone
I found it easy to make friends at my new school.
我发现在新学校很容易交到朋友。
make friends with sb，friends 用复数；不说 make a friend with。

volumes.name: 口语：描述地方与物品
words: pretty, especially in an old-fashioned way
We stayed in a picturesque village in the hills.
我们住在山里一个风景如画的村子。
形容乡村、小镇、风景，比 beautiful 更具体；不用来形容人。
The view from the top of the mountain was breathtaking.
山顶的景色美得令人惊叹。
形容景色最常用的强烈词：a breathtaking view。
My hometown has a bustling night market.
我的家乡有一个熙熙攘攘的夜市。
褒义的“热闹”；crowded 偏中性或贬义。
The old town is especially lively on summer evenings.
老城区在夏天的晚上特别热闹。
可以形容地方、气氛或人；a lively debate 热烈的讨论。
far away from places that many people visit
I prefer small villages that are off the beaten track.
我更喜欢那些远离游客的小村庄。
谈旅行偏好很地道：places off the beaten track。
in a quiet place that is hard to find
There's a lovely little café tucked away behind the station.
车站后面藏着一家很可爱的小咖啡馆。
描述“藏在某处的好地方”，后面接地点。
My flat is a stone's throw from the beach.
我的公寓离海滩只有几步路。
夸张地说“非常近”；也可以说 just a stone's throw away。
Rome has a vibrant cultural life.
罗马的文化生活充满活力。
比 lively 更书面一点；也可以形容颜色：vibrant colours。
The town is small but charming.
这个小镇不大，但很迷人。
形容地方、房子、人都可以，口语常用。
We took the scenic route along the coast.
我们走了沿海那条风景优美的路线。
常见搭配 a scenic route / spot / drive。
in bad condition because nobody has looked after it
The area used to be run-down, but it has improved a lot.
那个地区以前很破旧，但现在改善了很多。
形容建筑或街区；形容人是“疲惫不堪”。
I sometimes need to escape the hustle and bustle of the city.
我有时需要逃离城市的喧嚣。
固定说法 the hustle and bustle of city life，谈城乡对比好用。
The fireworks on New Year's Eve were spectacular.
跨年夜的烟花非常壮观。
形容景色、表演：a spectacular view / performance。
attractive in an unusual or old-fashioned way
We walked through quaint little streets full of old shops.
我们走过满是老店铺的古色古香的小街。
形容老房子、小村、老街，带“可爱”的意味。
a place far from towns and other people
My grandparents live in the middle of nowhere.
我爷爷奶奶住在荒郊野外。
in the middle of nowhere，常带抱怨或夸张的语气。
The beach is always packed in August.
八月份海滩总是挤满了人。
比 crowded 更口语：packed with people / tourists。
游客太多的；太商业化的
full of tourists and things for tourists (used to show disapproval)
The old town is beautiful but a bit too touristy.
老城区很美，但游客太多，有点商业化。
带贬义的口语词，表示“太旅游化”。
The streets were deserted early on Sunday morning.
星期天一大早街上空无一人。
形容街道、海滩没人；读音和 desert（沙漠）不同。
thought to be better than it really is
In my opinion, that famous restaurant is overrated.
在我看来，那家有名的餐馆被高估了。
评价景点、电影、餐馆很实用；反义 underrated。
something so good that you should see it
If you visit my city, the old castle is a must-see.
如果你来我的城市，老城堡是必去之处。
也说 a must-visit；同类结构有 a must-have、a must-read。
the town or city where you were born or grew up
My hometown is a small city in the south of China.
我的家乡是中国南方的一座小城市。
Part 1 高频；说 my hometown，前面不加 the。
born and brought up in a particular place
My father is Roman, born and bred.
我爸是土生土长的罗马人。
放在身份后面：I'm a Londoner, born and bred。
My bedroom is small but cosy.
我的卧室不大，但很温馨。
英式拼法 cosy（美式 cozy）；小但舒服的房间常用。
to go to live in a different home
We moved house three times when I was a child.
我小时候我们搬过三次家。
英式说法，house 前不加冠词；不说 move my house。
to start living in one place, often with a family
I'd like to settle down somewhere near the sea.
我想在海边某个地方安定下来。
指定居、成家；settle in 是“适应新环境”。
to feel relaxed and comfortable in a place
It took me a few months to feel at home in Rome.
我花了几个月才在罗马感到自在。
谈搬家、留学适应常用；Make yourself at home 是“请随意”。
We live in an up-and-coming area with lots of new cafés.
我们住在一个正在兴起的街区，开了很多新咖啡馆。
形容街区、新人：an up-and-coming area / artist。
the feeling of belonging to a group of people who live near each other
There's a strong sense of community in my village.
我们村子邻里之间很有归属感。
谈城乡对比、邻里关系时好用：a strong sense of community。
to change from a child into an adult
I grew up in a small town by the sea.
我在海边的一个小镇长大。
grow up in + 地方；“抚养孩子”是 bring up，不说 grow up my children。
We have a lovely park right on the doorstep.
我们家门口就有一个漂亮的公园。
表示很方便：have sth on your doorstep。
The area around my old school is very built-up now.
我以前学校周围现在全是楼房。
a built-up area 建成区，描述城市变化好用。
a place where you feel as comfortable as in your own home
My aunt's flat in Milan became a home from home for me.
我姨妈在米兰的公寓成了我的第二个家。
英式说法；美式说 a home away from home。
land outside towns and cities, with fields and farms
At weekends we often go for walks in the countryside.
周末我们常去乡下散步。
不可数，前面加 the：in the countryside。
to repair and decorate an old building
My parents spent a year doing up an old farmhouse.
我父母花了一年时间翻新一座老农舍。
英式口语，比 renovate 随意；do up 还可以指扣好扣子。
having good transport links; knowing important people
My neighbourhood is well-connected, with buses and a metro station.
我们街区交通便利，有公交还有地铁站。
形容地方是交通方便；形容人是人脉广。
to leave the place where you live
I moved out of my parents' house when I was nineteen.
我十九岁就从父母家搬出来了。
move out (of + 地方)；搬进是 move in。
with a lot of trees and plants (of an area)
They live in a quiet, leafy suburb.
他们住在一个安静、绿树成荫的郊区。
英式常用来形容安静体面的住宅区：a leafy suburb。
quiet and with little activity (of a place)
It's a sleepy little village where nothing much happens.
那是个冷清的小村子，平时没什么事发生。
形容地方“安静、没什么活力”；形容人是“困倦的”。
in the centre of a place
Our hotel was right in the heart of the old town.
我们的酒店就在老城的正中心。
比 in the centre of 更生动：in the heart of the city。
people who live in a particular place
The locals were very friendly and helped us find the way.
当地人很友好，帮我们找路。
口语里常用复数名词 the locals；也说 local people。
This little bag is really handy for travelling.
这个小包旅行时特别方便。
口语常用：handy for + 用途；也可以表示离某处近。
I bought a brand-new bike with my first salary.
我用第一份工资买了一辆全新的自行车。
强调“崭新的”，比 new 更有感情。
importance because of personal memories, not money
The watch isn't expensive, but it has great sentimental value.
这块手表不贵，但很有纪念意义。
Part 2 描述珍贵物品必备：It has sentimental value because…
I still treasure the letters my grandfather wrote to me.
我至今珍藏着爷爷写给我的信。
动词表示“珍藏、珍视”：treasure memories / a gift。
to love and care for something very much
I cherish the time I spent with my grandparents.
我很怀念和爷爷奶奶一起度过的时光。
常接回忆、关系：cherish memories / a friendship。
My grandmother still uses an old-fashioned sewing machine.
我奶奶还在用一台老式缝纫机。
可褒可贬：可以是“老派可爱”，也可以是“过时”。
There are lots of trendy bars in the city centre.
市中心有很多新潮的酒吧。
口语词，形容衣服、地方、人；有时略带讽刺。
The shop has an eye-catching window display.
那家店的橱窗陈列很吸引眼球。
形容设计、颜色、广告：an eye-catching design。
This jacket is expensive, but it's very well-made.
这件夹克很贵，但做工很好。
描述物品质量；反义 badly made / cheaply made。
to be useful at some time
My pocket knife came in handy on our camping trip.
我的小折刀在露营时派上了用场。
常用将来或过去时：It'll come in handy / It came in handy。
something that everyone wants to own
A good pair of walking shoes is a must-have in Rome.
在罗马，一双好走的鞋是必备品。
也可作形容词：a must-have gadget；同类有 a must-see。
to break into pieces because it is old or badly made
My old schoolbag finally fell apart after ten years.
我的旧书包用了十年，终于散架了。
形容旧东西坏掉；也可以指计划、关系或人“崩溃”。
made by hand, not by machine
My aunt gave me a hand-made scarf for my birthday.
我姨妈送了我一条手织围巾作生日礼物。
也写作 handmade；描述礼物时显得用心。
a small object you keep to remember a person or event
I kept the ticket as a keepsake of the concert.
我把那张票留下，作为那场音乐会的纪念。
强调个人纪念意义；souvenir 多指旅游纪念品。
a valuable object that has belonged to a family for many years
This ring is a family heirloom that belonged to my great-grandmother.
这枚戒指是传家宝，曾属于我的曾祖母。
常说 a family heirloom；h 不发音。
My old laptop was so bulky that I never took it anywhere.
我的旧笔记本电脑太笨重了，我从来不带它出门。
形容体积大、不好拿；反义 compact / lightweight。
using the newest methods or technology
The new gym has state-of-the-art equipment.
新健身房的设备是最先进的。
放名词前要加连字符：state-of-the-art equipment。
difficult to do or use because small parts are involved
Changing the battery in this watch is really fiddly.
给这块手表换电池特别麻烦。
英式口语，形容需要手指精细操作的东西。
old and damaged from a lot of use
He still carries a battered old suitcase from his student days.
他还拎着学生时代那只破旧的手提箱。
常和 old 连用：a battered old car / guitar，带感情色彩。
My camera is compact enough to fit in my pocket.
我的相机小巧得可以放进口袋。
褒义的“小”；a compact flat 小而紧凑的公寓。

volumes.name: 口语：经历与故事
words: used to introduce a memory that is very important to you
I'll never forget the first time I saw the sea.
我永远不会忘记第一次看见大海的情景。
Part 2 开头或结尾好用：I'll never forget the day…
very special and unlikely to happen again
Seeing the northern lights was a once-in-a-lifetime experience.
看到北极光是一生难得的经历。
放名词前要加连字符：a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity。
worth remembering or easy to remember
My most memorable trip was a week in Japan.
我最难忘的一次旅行是在日本待的那一周。
Part 2 高频题目词：Describe a memorable event…
so good or special that you cannot forget it
Our trip to the mountains was an unforgettable experience.
那次山区之旅是一段难以忘怀的经历。
比 memorable 语气更强：an unforgettable experience / moment。
full of interesting or important events
It was an eventful day: I lost my phone and then won a prize.
那天事情真多：我丢了手机，然后又得了奖。
可以是好事也可以是坏事；反义 uneventful（平淡的）。
We made a spontaneous decision to drive to the coast.
我们一时兴起，决定开车去海边。
形容决定或人：a spontaneous trip / person。
We set off early in the morning to avoid the traffic.
我们一大早就出发，以避开堵车。
讲旅行开头常用：set off for + 目的地。
to finally be in a place or situation you did not plan
We got lost and ended up in a tiny village.
我们迷了路，结果到了一个小村子。
end up + doing / in + 地点，讲故事的意外结局很地道。
to find or meet by chance
I came across an old photo of my parents while cleaning.
打扫时我偶然发现了一张父母的老照片。
come across sth / sb 偶然发现；come across as 给人……的印象。
to be unable to find your way
We got lost in the narrow streets of Venice.
我们在威尼斯狭窄的街道里迷了路。
讲旅行经历很常用；Get lost! 是粗鲁的“滚开”，别对人说。
to meet someone and talk about what has happened since you last met
I met an old friend for coffee to catch up with her.
我约了一位老朋友喝咖啡叙叙旧。
catch up with sb 叙旧或赶上进度；名词 a catch-up。
to guide someone around a place
My cousin showed me around the old town.
我表姐带我参观了老城。
show sb around + 地方，人放中间。
a trip for one day to somewhere enjoyable
We had a lovely day out at the seaside.
我们在海边度过了愉快的一天。
英式说法：have a day out at / in…
Travelling alone for the first time was a real adventure.
第一次独自旅行真是一次冒险。
go on an adventure；形容词 adventurous 爱冒险的。
to have the opportunity to do something
I'd love to visit Iceland if I get the chance.
如果有机会，我很想去冰岛。
get the chance to do sth；谈愿望时 if I get the chance 很自然。
to visit famous or interesting places as a tourist
We went sightseeing in Florence for two days.
我们在佛罗伦萨观光了两天。
go sightseeing 不加 to；名词 sightseeing 不可数。
on the spur of the moment
We booked the trip on the spur of the moment.
我们一时冲动订了那次旅行。
An old school friend called me out of the blue last week.
上周一个老同学突然给我打电话。
讲故事里的意外转折，放句末很自然。
I bumped into my old teacher at the supermarket.
我在超市偶遇了以前的老师。
bump into sb 偶遇熟人，口语很常用；字面也指“撞到”。
to arrive, often unexpectedly or late
Only five people turned up for the meeting.
只有五个人来参加会议。
常指（出乎意料地）出现：turn up late / turn up at…
at the beginning, often before a change
At first I hated living alone, but now I love it.
起初我很讨厌一个人住，现在却很喜欢。
暗示后来有变化；和 first of all（首先，列举）不同。
finally, after a lot of time or changes
We waited for hours, but in the end the flight was cancelled.
我们等了好几个小时，最后航班还是取消了。
讲故事的结局；at the end of + 名词 才是“在……末尾”。
All of a sudden, the lights went out.
比 suddenly 更生动，讲故事时制造转折。
I was about to leave. Just then, my phone rang.
我正要走，就在那时，电话响了。
讲故事时引出关键时刻。
A few years back, I worked in a café in London.
几年前，我在伦敦一家咖啡馆工作。
比 ago 更随意，口语里可以换着用。
These days, I mostly listen to podcasts on my way to work.
如今我上班路上主要听播客。
和 back then / in the past 对比，讲变化时很常用。
at that time in the past
Back then, nobody had a smartphone.
那时候还没人有智能手机。
at that time, in those days
讲过去和现在的对比：Back then…, but these days…
When I was a kid, I spent every summer at my grandparents' house.
我小时候每个夏天都在爷爷奶奶家过。
比 when I was a child 更随意，Part 1 谈童年常用。
from a time in the past until now
I tried sushi in Tokyo, and I've loved it ever since.
我在东京尝了寿司，从那以后就一直爱吃。
常和现在完成时连用；放句末或 ever since + 从句。
I still play the piano from time to time.
代替 sometimes，回答频率类问题时更有变化。
Every now and then, we have a family barbecue.
我们家时不时会搞个烧烤。
也说 every now and again。
Once in a while, I go to a nice restaurant on my own.
偶尔我会一个人去家好餐馆吃饭。
频率比 from time to time 更低一点。
while something else is happening, or until something happens
The bus was late, so in the meantime we had a coffee.
公交车晚了，于是我们趁这段时间喝了杯咖啡。
讲故事时连接两件同时发生的事。
Later on, I realised that my teacher had been right.
后来我才意识到老师是对的。
讲经历的顺序：at first…, later on…, in the end…
I haven't seen my cousins for ages.
我很久没见我的表兄弟姐妹了。
口语里的夸张说法，常和现在完成时连用。
I saw a great documentary the other day.
前几天我看了一部很棒的纪录片。
放句末，不是“另一天”的意思。
at a particular moment in the past
At the time, I didn't understand why my parents were so strict.
当时我不明白父母为什么那么严格。
表示当时的想法后来变了：At the time I thought…, but now…
I was nervous at first, but before long I was enjoying myself.
一开始我很紧张，但不久就玩得很开心了。
讲故事推进时间；别和 long before（很久以前）混淆。
By the time we arrived, the museum had closed.
等我们到的时候，博物馆已经关门了。
主句常用过去完成时：By the time…, it had…
used to say what was finally discovered to be true
It turned out that the restaurant was closed on Mondays.
结果那家餐馆周一不营业。
It turned out (that) + 句子；也说 as it turned out。
used to say that something good happened by chance
Luckily, someone found my wallet and handed it in.
幸运的是，有人捡到我的钱包并交了上去。
讲经历转折时用；fortunately 更正式。
deserving the effort, time or money spent
The climb was hard, but the view made it worth it.
爬山很辛苦，但那风景让一切都值了。
It was worth it；语气更强说 well worth it。
The meeting was a complete waste of time.
那次会议完全是在浪费时间。
a complete / total waste of time 语气更强。
something that seems bad at first but brings good results
Losing that job was a blessing in disguise.
丢了那份工作反倒是件好事。
讲“坏事变好事”的经历，Part 2 的加分表达。
to learn from a bad experience not to do something again
I missed a flight once and learned my lesson: now I always arrive early.
我误过一次航班，吸取了教训，现在总是提早到。
learn one's lesson；teach sb a lesson 是“给某人一个教训”。
an experience that teaches you something surprising
Volunteering abroad was a real eye-opener for me.
去国外做志愿者让我大开眼界。
a real eye-opener，谈经历带来的收获很好用。
Moving closer to work made a big difference to my life.
搬到离公司近的地方，对我的生活影响很大。
make a (big) difference to sth；make no difference 没区别。
to not value something because you have always had it
I used to take my parents' cooking for granted.
我以前把父母做饭当成理所当然的事。
take sth / sb for granted，宾语放中间。
to bring good results after a lot of effort
All those hours of practice finally paid off.
那么多小时的练习终于有了回报。
hard work pays off 努力有回报；pay off a debt 是还清债务。
to stop happening in the way you planned
Everything went wrong on the day of the wedding.
婚礼那天一切都出了岔子。
something went wrong；机器出故障也可以用。
Our holiday plans fell through at the last minute.
我们的度假计划在最后一刻泡汤了。
主语是计划、交易：the deal / plan fell through。
Looking back, I wish I had studied harder at school.
回想起来，我真希望上学时更用功一些。
Part 2 收尾总结常用：Looking back, …
when you think about a past event with the knowledge you have now
In hindsight, choosing that university was the right decision.
事后看来，选那所大学是正确的决定。
比 looking back 正式一点；也说 with hindsight。
to feel sorry about something you did or did not do
I regret not learning to play an instrument.
regret doing 后悔做过；regret not doing 后悔没做；I have no regrets 我不后悔。
the most enjoyable part of something
The best part of the trip was swimming in the lake.
这次旅行最棒的是在湖里游泳。
The best part was…；也说 the highlight was…
a situation in which something bad almost happened
We nearly missed the last train; it was a close call.
我们差点错过末班车，真是好险。
a near miss, a narrow escape
close 读 /kləʊs/；也说 a close shave。
It took me weeks to get over the flu.
我花了好几周才从流感中恢复过来。
get over an illness / a shock / a break-up。
used to say that you are glad something happened
Thankfully, nobody was hurt in the accident.
谢天谢地，事故中没有人受伤。
to happen in the way that you hoped
Visiting Rome was a dream come true for me.
来罗马对我来说是梦想成真。
my dream came true；a dream come true 是固定说法。

volumes.name: 口语：感受与情绪
words: I was thrilled when I got my first job offer.
我收到第一份工作录用时激动极了。
比 happy 强烈得多：be thrilled to do / with sth / that…
My parents were delighted with their anniversary present.
我父母很喜欢他们的结婚纪念日礼物。
be delighted with / at sth、be delighted to do；比 pleased 更强。
happy because something bad did not happen or has ended
I was so relieved when my exam results came out.
考试成绩出来时我大大松了口气。
be relieved that / to do；名词 relief：What a relief!
pleased about something you or someone close to you has done
My parents were proud of me when I finished my degree.
我拿到学位时父母为我骄傲。
be proud of sb / sth；take pride in 以……为豪。
I'm really grateful to my teachers for their support.
我非常感激老师们的支持。
be grateful to sb for sth；人前用 to，事前用 for。
happy and satisfied with what you have
I'm quite content with a simple life.
我对简单的生活很知足。
形容词重音在后 /kənˈtent/；名词 content（内容）重音在前。
I was amazed by how friendly everyone was.
大家都那么友好，让我很惊讶。
人感到 amazed，让人惊叹的事物是 amazing，-ed 和 -ing 别混用。
I was really impressed by the museum's collection.
博物馆的藏品给我留下了很深的印象。
be impressed by / with sth；让人钦佩的事物用 impressive。
As a child, I was fascinated by dinosaurs.
be fascinated by / with sth；比 interested 强很多。
showing a lot of interest and excitement
She's very enthusiastic about learning Italian.
她对学意大利语非常热衷。
be enthusiastic about sth；名词 enthusiasm。
having very strong feelings about something
My uncle is passionate about football.
be passionate about + 爱好或事业，谈爱好比 like 有力。
to be very excited about something that is going to happen
I can't wait to see my family again.
我迫不及待想再见到家人。
can't wait to do / for sth，谈将来的计划时表达期待。
pleased because you have got what you wanted
I'm fairly satisfied with my progress in English.
我对自己英语的进步还算满意。
be satisfied with sth；dissatisfied 不满意的。
The fans were ecstatic when their team won the cup.
球队夺冠时，球迷们欣喜若狂。
程度最强的“开心”之一，形容特别的时刻。
I was really chuffed with my exam result.
我对这次考试成绩挺高兴的。
英式非正式用语：be chuffed with / about sth。
I was pleasantly surprised by how cheap the tickets were.
票价那么便宜，让我很惊喜。
表达“没想到还不错”，评价经历很自然。
My host family made me feel at ease from the first day.
我的寄宿家庭从第一天起就让我觉得很自在。
feel at ease、put sb at ease；反义 ill at ease。
I miss the carefree summers of my childhood.
我怀念童年时无忧无虑的夏天。
常形容童年、假期：a carefree childhood。
feeling emotional because someone has been kind
I was touched that my students remembered my birthday.
学生们记得我的生日，我很感动。
be touched by sth / that…；也可以说 moved。
Our neighbour is always cheerful, even on rainy days.
我们的邻居总是乐呵呵的，下雨天也一样。
形容人的性情，也可以形容颜色、房间：a cheerful room。
annoyed because you cannot do what you want
I get frustrated when I can't find the right word in English.
用英语找不到合适的词时，我会很懊恼。
因为做不到而烦躁：get frustrated with sth。
I was annoyed because the train was late again.
火车又晚点了，我很恼火。
be annoyed with sb / about sth；让人烦的事物用 annoying。
unhappy or worried because something bad has happened
She was upset when she didn't get the job.
她没得到那份工作，很难过。
情绪上的难过；an upset stomach 是肠胃不适。
sad because something was not as good as you hoped
I was disappointed with the hotel; it looked nothing like the photos.
那家酒店让我很失望，和照片完全不一样。
be disappointed with / in / by；令人失望的事是 disappointing。
I get really stressed out before exams.
口语说法，比 stressed 更强；名词 stress。
worried about something that is going to happen
I always feel nervous before speaking in public.
在公众面前讲话之前，我总是很紧张。
be nervous about sth / doing，谈考试、面试常用。
feeling uncomfortable because of something silly you did
I was so embarrassed when I called my teacher Mum.
我把老师叫成了“妈妈”，尴尬极了。
拼写是双 r 双 s；令人尴尬的事是 embarrassing。
After a long day of sightseeing, we were completely worn out.
观光了一整天，我们彻底累垮了。
形容人是“累坏了”，形容东西是“用坏了”。
bored or annoyed with something that has gone on too long
I'm fed up with the rain; it's been raining for a week.
我受够了这雨，已经下了一个星期了。
be fed up with sth / doing，英式口语很常用。
不知所措的；难以承受的
feeling that something is too much to deal with
I felt overwhelmed during my first week at university.
大学第一周我感到不知所措。
可以是事情太多，也可以是情绪太强：overwhelmed with joy。
I was confused by the bus timetable.
公交时刻表让我一头雾水。
人感到 confused，让人困惑的事是 confusing。
unhappy because someone has something you want
I was a bit jealous of my friend's trip to Japan.
我有点嫉妒朋友去日本旅行。
be jealous of sb；口语里常半开玩笑：I'm so jealous!
I used to be scared of the dark.
be scared of sth / to do；口语里比 afraid 常用。
My dad was furious when someone damaged his car.
有人弄坏了我爸的车，他大发雷霆。
比 angry 强得多：be furious with sb / about sth。
annoyed, especially by something that keeps happening
I get irritated when people talk loudly on the phone.
别人大声打电话时，我会觉得很烦。
常因反复发生的小事而烦；也可以指皮肤发炎。
She was devastated when her dog died.
她的狗死了，她伤心欲绝。
非常强烈的悲伤，用于重大坏消息。
I was gutted when the concert was cancelled.
音乐会取消了，我失望透了。
英式非正式用语，年轻人常说。
be terrified of sth，比 scared 强得多。
I was bored stiff during the three-hour lecture.
那三个小时的讲座让我无聊透顶。
口语夸张说法；也说 bored to tears。
I felt lonely during my first month abroad.
在国外的第一个月我感到很孤独。
lonely 是感到孤独；alone 只是“独自一人”，不一定难过。
My mum was over the moon when I passed my driving test.
我通过驾照考试时，我妈高兴坏了。
英式口语，比 very happy 地道得多：be over the moon about sth。
I've been a bit down in the dumps since the holidays ended.
假期结束后，我一直有点闷闷不乐。
非正式，只描述一时的低落，不是抑郁症。
I sometimes feel blue on grey winter days.
阴沉的冬日我有时会感到忧郁。
blue 表示忧郁，轻度的难过。
I was on edge all morning waiting for the phone call.
我整个上午都在紧张地等那个电话。
be on edge，比 nervous 更强调坐立不安。
a nervous feeling before something important
I had butterflies in my stomach before my first presentation.
第一次做报告前，我心里七上八下的。
have butterflies (in my stomach)，形容考试、面试前的紧张。
at the end of my tether
so tired or annoyed that you cannot deal with any more
After a week of noisy building work next door, I was at the end of my tether.
隔壁吵闹的施工持续了一周，我已经忍无可忍了。
英式说法；美式说 at the end of my rope。
a feeling of relief after a problem is solved
Finishing my thesis was a weight off my shoulders.
写完论文让我如释重负。
也说 a load off my mind。
used to encourage someone to stay positive
My coach told me to keep my chin up after we lost.
比赛输了以后，教练叫我别灰心。
鼓励别人：Keep your chin up!；转述时变成 keep my chin up。
My father rarely loses his temper.
lose one's temper (with sb)；反义 keep one's temper。
to do something that helps you get rid of strong feelings or energy
I go running after work to let off steam.
我下班后去跑步，发泄一下情绪。
谈减压方式很实用：Sport helps me let off steam。
very bored or annoyed with something
I'm sick and tired of waiting for the bus every morning.
每天早上等公交，我已经烦透了。
be sick and tired of + 名词/doing，比 fed up 更强烈。
Everyone was in high spirits at the end-of-term party.
期末派对上大家都兴高采烈。
常形容一群人的气氛；反义 in low spirits。
At weekends I like to chill out at home with a good film.
周末我喜欢在家看部好电影放松一下。
非正式，Part 1 谈周末很自然；也可以只说 chill。
to become less angry, upset or excited
It took me a few minutes to calm down after the argument.
吵完架，我花了几分钟才冷静下来。
对别人说 Calm down! 可能显得不礼貌，讲自己时更自然。
to become happier, or make someone happier
A phone call from my best friend always cheers me up.
最好的朋友打来电话，总能让我开心起来。
cheer sb up 让某人高兴；Cheer up! 别难过了。
to suddenly become very frightened or upset (informal)
I freaked out when I couldn't find my passport.
找不到护照时我吓坏了。
非正式，年轻人常说；讲故事时偶尔用一次就好。
The noise from the building site really gets on my nerves.
工地的噪音真让我心烦。
get on sb's nerves，主语是让人烦的人或事。
When I finally reached the summit, I felt on top of the world.
终于登上山顶时，我感觉棒极了。
feel on top of the world，形容成功后的喜悦。
A kind message from an old friend really made my day.
老朋友一条暖心的信息让我开心了一整天。
主语是让你开心的小事：Your message made my day。
My neighbour's barking dog drives me mad.
邻居家的狗一直叫，快把我逼疯了。
drive sb mad / crazy；英式多用 mad。

volumes.name: 口语：爱好、饮食与购物
words: enjoying something so much that you want to do it all the time
I got hooked on crime novels last summer.
去年夏天我迷上了侦探小说。
be / get hooked on + 名词，谈爱好很地道。
to watch many episodes of a series one after another
We binge-watched the whole series in one weekend.
我们一个周末就把整部剧刷完了。
谈流媒体习惯的新词；binge on sth 是狂吃、狂看。
I was a real bookworm as a teenager.
我十几岁时是个十足的书虫。
Part 1 谈阅读：I'm a bit of a bookworm。
to relax after work or effort
I like to unwind with some music after a long day.
忙了一天后，我喜欢听点音乐放松一下。
to rest so that you have energy again
A week by the sea helps me recharge my batteries.
在海边待一周能让我恢复精力。
recharge your batteries，谈度假、休息的作用。
time you spend on your own, doing what you enjoy
Sunday morning is my me time; I read and drink coffee.
周日上午是我自己的时间，我看书、喝咖啡。
非正式；也说 time to myself。
to start being interested in something
I got into photography when I was at university.
我上大学时开始喜欢摄影。
get into + 爱好，讲爱好是怎么开始的。
to start doing a new activity
I took up yoga last year to help with stress.
去年我开始练瑜伽来缓解压力。
take up a hobby / sport；放弃是 give up。
to spend time relaxing with friends (informal)
At weekends I usually hang out with friends in the city centre.
周末我通常和朋友在市中心玩。
hang out with sb / at + 地点，非正式但考试可用。
an evening spent at home, not going out
After a busy week, I prefer a quiet night in.
忙了一周后，我更喜欢晚上安静地待在家里。
反义 a night out（晚上出去玩）。
easy to remember (of a tune or phrase)
The song has a really catchy chorus.
这首歌的副歌特别上口。
形容旋律、广告语：a catchy tune / slogan。
a very successful film or book
I usually prefer small independent films to Hollywood blockbusters.
比起好莱坞大片，我通常更喜欢小成本独立电影。
a Hollywood blockbuster，谈电影偏好常用。
a book that is so exciting you want to keep reading
The novel was a real page-turner; I finished it in two days.
那本小说太好看了，我两天就看完了。
夸一本书好看的地道说法。
information that tells you what happens in a story before you see it
Don't tell me the ending of the series; I hate spoilers.
别告诉我这部剧的结局，我最讨厌剧透。
No spoilers! 别剧透；spoiler alert 剧透预警。
to do something while you are waiting
I play games on my phone to kill time on the train.
坐火车时我玩手机游戏打发时间。
带“无聊等待”的意味；while away the time 更文雅。
to do what you want, independently of others
On holiday, I like to do my own thing instead of joining tours.
度假时我喜欢自由行动，而不是跟团。
do one's own thing，谈独处、自由行。
to stay healthy by doing exercise
I swim twice a week to keep fit.
我每周游两次泳来保持健康。
英式常用；也说 stay fit / stay in shape。
a good feeling when you succeed at something difficult
Finishing a marathon gave me a huge sense of achievement.
跑完马拉松给了我巨大的成就感。
谈爱好的好处：It gives me a sense of achievement。
to go for a slow, relaxed walk
After dinner we often go for a stroll along the river.
晚饭后我们常沿着河边散步。
stroll 是悠闲地走，比 go for a walk 更有画面感。
I'm not very outdoorsy; I'd rather visit a museum than go hiking.
我不太爱户外活动，宁愿逛博物馆也不想去徒步。
非正式口语，描述自己的性格和爱好。
a person who loves food and cooking
As a foodie, I always try the local dishes when I travel.
作为一个吃货，我旅行时总会尝当地菜。
比 gourmet 随意，带褒义。
Nothing beats a home-cooked meal after a long trip.
长途旅行回来，什么都比不上一顿家常饭。
a home-cooked meal，和外卖、快餐对比时常用。
a meal bought from a restaurant to eat at home
On Friday nights we usually order a takeaway.
周五晚上我们通常点外卖。
英式 takeaway，美式 takeout：order a takeaway。
I've always had a sweet tooth, especially for chocolate.
我一直爱吃甜食，尤其是巧克力。
have a sweet tooth，不说 sweet teeth。
simple food that makes you feel better
For me, noodle soup is the ultimate comfort food.
对我来说，汤面是最能抚慰人心的食物。
谈家乡菜、心情不好时吃什么。
someone who refuses to eat many kinds of food
I was a fussy eater as a child, but now I'll eat anything.
我小时候很挑食，现在什么都吃。
We grabbed a bite at the station before the film.
看电影前我们在车站随便吃了点东西。
非正式；也说 grab a bite to eat。
The bakery near my flat sells mouth-watering pastries.
我家附近的面包店卖的糕点让人垂涎欲滴。
描述食物比 delicious 更形象。
I prefer savoury snacks like crisps to sweets.
比起糖果，我更喜欢薯片之类的咸味零食。
英式拼法 savoury，和 sweet 相对。
Hospital food is often quite bland.
医院的饭菜往往很寡淡。
贬义的“清淡”；健康清淡可以说 light。
形容食物分量足；名词 filling 是“馅”。
to eat, drink or do less of something
I'm trying to cut down on sugar.
cut down on + 名词；完全戒掉是 cut out / give up。
My sister went vegetarian two years ago.
我姐姐两年前开始吃素了。
go + 形容词表示转变：go vegan / go organic。
to eat while travelling or doing other things
Many office workers eat on the go.
the wish to eat a lot of food
Teenage boys usually have a healthy appetite.
十几岁的男孩通常胃口很大。
委婉地说“能吃”；没胃口是 lose your appetite。
to like something so much that you want more and more
I can't get enough of Italian ice cream.
意大利冰淇淋我怎么吃都吃不够。
强烈的喜欢，谈食物、音乐都行。
something special that gives you pleasure
We have pizza as a treat on Saturday nights.
周六晚上我们吃比萨犒劳一下自己。
as a treat 作为犒劳；It's my treat 我请客。
I skipped lunch, so I'm absolutely starving.
我没吃午饭，现在饿坏了。
food that remains after a meal
I often take leftovers to work for lunch.
我常把剩菜带去公司当午饭。
常用复数；谈浪费食物的话题也用得上。
We eat out about once a week.
我们大约每周下一次馆子。
Part 1 饮食话题高频：Do you prefer eating out or cooking at home?
looking at things in shops without buying
I enjoy window-shopping, but I rarely buy anything.
我喜欢逛街看看，但很少买东西。
to spend a lot of money on something you do not really need
I splashed out on a new coat for the winter.
我花大价钱买了件过冬的新大衣。
英式口语：splash out on sth。
to compare prices in different shops before buying
It's worth shopping around before you buy a phone.
买手机前货比三家很值得。
The restaurant was a bit pricey, but the food was excellent.
那家餐馆有点贵，但菜很好吃。
口语里比 expensive 随意；也写作 pricy。
something that costs much more than it should (informal)
Ten euros for a coffee is a complete rip-off.
一杯咖啡十欧元，简直是宰人。
名词 a rip-off；动词 rip sb off 敲某人竹杠。
to buy or do something special for yourself
When I get paid, I sometimes treat myself to a new book.
发工资时，我有时会买本新书犒劳自己。
treat oneself to sth；treat sb to sth 是请某人吃或买。
to share the cost of a meal equally
When I eat out with friends, we usually go Dutch.
我和朋友出去吃饭，通常各付各的。
也说 split the bill，谈消费习惯、文化差异可用。
Renting a flat in the city centre costs a fortune.
在市中心租房要花一大笔钱。
cost an arm and a leg
口语夸张；spend a fortune on sth 在……上花大钱。
available at a lower price than usual; available to buy
I bought these trainers when they were on sale.
这双运动鞋是打折时买的。
英式 on sale 也指“在售”；打折季也说 in the sale。
to keep money so that you can buy something later
I'm saving up for a trip to Australia.
我在攒钱去澳大利亚旅行。
save up for sth，谈理财和目标。
A weekend in the countryside doesn't have to break the bank.
去乡下过个周末不一定要花很多钱。
常用否定：It won't break the bank 花不了多少钱。
a person who loves shopping and cannot stop
My cousin is a bit of a shopaholic.
to look at things in a shop or online without a clear plan to buy
I love browsing in second-hand bookshops.
我喜欢在二手书店里随便翻翻。
店员招呼时可以说 I'm just browsing（我只是看看）。
money returned to you after you buy something
My bank card gives me cashback on supermarket shopping.
我的银行卡在超市购物可以返现。
I was quite hard up when I was a student.
我当学生时手头挺紧的。
英式口语；更随意的说法是 broke。
good enough to justify its cost
The concert tickets were expensive, but worth every penny.
音乐会门票很贵，但每一分钱都花得值。
强调值得，评价购物或体验。
to argue about the price of something
In some markets you're expected to haggle.
在有些市场里，讨价还价是常规操作。
haggle over the price，谈购物文化差异。
not willing to spend or give money
My uncle is so stingy that he never buys a round of drinks.
我叔叔太小气了，从来不请大家喝一轮。
贬义；英式也说 mean（小气），别误解成“刻薄”。
something bought at a good price
I got a good deal on my laptop in the January sales.
一月份打折时，我很划算地买了笔记本电脑。
get a good deal on sth；a good deal of 也表示“大量”。
to spend no more money than you earn
My parents taught me to live within my means.
反义 live beyond your means（入不敷出）。

volumes.name: 口语：学习、工作与习语
words: to improve a skill you have not used for a while
I need to brush up on my French before the trip.
旅行前我得把法语重新捡起来。
brush up (on) + 技能，谈语言学习很地道。
to learn something so that you can remember it exactly
We had to learn the poem by heart for the school concert.
为了学校的演出，我们得把那首诗背下来。
learn sth by heart，宾语放中间；比 memorise 口语。
to fail to make progress as quickly as others
I fell behind in maths when I was ill for a month.
我病了一个月，数学就跟不上了。
fall behind (in / with sth)；反义 keep up / catch up。
to stay awake all night to study or work
I pulled an all-nighter before my history exam.
历史考试前我熬了个通宵。
非正式口语，谈学生生活很生动。
要在短时间内学很多东西
a situation where you have to learn a lot very quickly
My first job was a steep learning curve.
我的第一份工作要在短时间内学很多东西。
常说 It was a steep learning curve，意思是“很难、要学的很多”。
Exams start next week, so it's time to hit the books.
下周就考试了，该埋头苦读了。
非正式习语，美式更常用，英式也听得懂。
to learn how to do something
Driving was hard at first, but I soon got the hang of it.
开车一开始很难，但我很快就掌握了窍门。
get the hang of it / doing sth，讲学技能的过程。
to study a lot in a short time before an exam
I don't like cramming the night before an exam.
我不喜欢考试前一晚临时抱佛脚。
cram for an exam；还有“塞满”的意思：cram into a small room。
to move or progress at the same speed as others
It's hard to keep up with the reading for my course.
要跟上课程的阅读量很难。
keep up with sb / sth；也可以指跟上新闻、潮流。
to pass an exam or test easily
She sailed through her driving test.
她轻松通过了驾照考试。
someone who learns new things quickly
I'm a fast learner, so I picked up the new software quickly.
我学东西快，所以很快就会用新软件了。
面试和自我介绍常用：I'm a fast learner。
I struggled with English grammar at school.
我上学时英语语法学得很吃力。
struggle with sth、struggle to do sth，谈学习困难。
having learned something by yourself, without a teacher
My brother is a self-taught guitarist.
我弟弟的吉他是自学的。
形容人或技能：a self-taught programmer。
I spent the whole weekend swotting for my exams.
我整个周末都在为考试用功。
英式口语；swot up on sth 突击学习；名词 a swot 略带贬义。
to work less hard than before
I tend to slack off when the weather is nice.
天气一好我就容易懈怠。
非正式，形容学习、工作不再用功。
to learn how to do a job or activity
It took me a few weeks to learn the ropes at my new school.
我花了几周时间才摸清新学校的门道。
新工作、新环境常用；show sb the ropes 是教某人入门。
not as good as before because you have not practised
My German is a bit rusty because I haven't used it for years.
我的德语有点生疏了，因为好多年没用了。
谈语言或技能退步：My French is a bit rusty。
to not go to lessons when you should
I never skipped classes, even when I was tired.
我从不逃课，累的时候也不。
英式也说 play truant，美式说 cut class。
the best student in the class
My best friend was always top of the class in science.
我最好的朋友理科总是全班第一。
be top of the class (in sth)。
to pass an exam very successfully
She passed her final exams with flying colours.
她以优异成绩通过了期末考试。
英式拼写 colours，描述考试成功的经典说法。
a day when you do not have to work
On my day off, I like to sleep late and go for a walk.
休息日我喜欢睡懒觉，然后去散步。
take a day off 请一天假；have a day off 休息一天。
My aunt runs a small business selling handmade jewellery.
我姨妈经营一家卖手工首饰的小生意。
run 在这里是“经营”：run a shop / restaurant。
having too much work to deal with
I'm snowed under with work at the moment.
我最近工作忙得不可开交。
be snowed under (with sth)，形容事情多到被“埋住”。
to finish something by the time it has to be done
We worked late to meet the deadline.
我们加班到很晚，才按期完成。
反义 miss a deadline；deadline 是截止日期。
to accept work or responsibility; to employ someone
I took on too much work last month and felt exhausted.
上个月我揽了太多活，累坏了。
take on work / responsibility；take on staff 是雇人。
someone who enjoys being with other people and works well with them
I'm a people person, so I'd love a job in customer service.
我很擅长和人打交道，所以想做客服工作。
谈理想职业和性格的好说法。
to move up to better jobs in your career
My cousin climbed the career ladder quickly at his bank.
我表哥在银行里升得很快。
谈职业发展：climb (up) the career ladder。
Job-hunting can be stressful for new graduates.
找工作对应届毕业生来说可能压力很大。
go job-hunting；动词 hunt for a job。
to start in a low position and gradually reach a higher one
My mother worked her way up from waitress to restaurant manager.
我妈妈从服务员一步步做到了餐厅经理。
work one's way up (from… to…)，讲励志经历。
to stop working for the day
We'd been painting for six hours, so we called it a day.
我们刷了六个小时漆，就收工了。
收工、结束；也可以指退休或结束某事。
to become extremely tired from working too hard
If you work seventy hours a week, you'll soon burn out.
如果每周工作七十小时，你很快就会累垮。
名词 burnout 职业倦怠，Part 3 谈工作压力好用。
a job with no chance of promotion
He left his dead-end job and went back to university.
他辞掉了没前途的工作，回大学读书了。
a person who works too much
My boss is a workaholic who answers emails at midnight.
我老板是个工作狂，半夜还回邮件。
-aholic 表示上瘾，和 shopaholic 一样。
to earn the money you need to live
It's hard to earn a living as an artist.
earn / make a living (as / by doing)。
to have just enough money to pay for what you need
Many young families struggle to make ends meet.
许多年轻家庭难以维持收支平衡。
常和 struggle to、it's hard to 连用。
a job for only part of the working week
I had a part-time job in a bookshop while I was at university.
我上大学时在书店做兼职。
to work for yourself and not for an employer
I'd love to be my own boss one day.
我希望有一天能自己当老板。
谈理想工作：I'd like to be my own boss。
involving doing something rather than only learning about it
I prefer hands-on jobs to sitting at a desk all day.
比起整天坐在办公桌前，我更喜欢动手的工作。
hands-on experience 实践经验，求职话题常用。
He got the sack for being late too often.
他因为经常迟到被炒了鱿鱼。
英式口语；正式说 be dismissed，美式说 get fired。
giving satisfaction, even if not much money
Teaching is hard work, but it's very rewarding.
教书很辛苦，但很有成就感。
谈工作价值常用：a rewarding job / experience。
The first part of the test was a piece of cake.
考试的第一部分简直是小菜一碟。
口语里形容非常容易，不要用在正式写作中。
I only go to the cinema once in a blue moon.
回答频率题时很地道：Once in a blue moon。
cost an arm and a leg
Concert tickets cost an arm and a leg these days.
如今演唱会门票贵得要命。
夸张地说很贵，口语常用。
to make people feel more relaxed when they first meet
Our teacher played a game to break the ice on the first day.
第一天老师玩了个游戏来活跃气氛。
名词 icebreaker 破冰游戏；谈初次见面。
a situation in which you have the advantages of two different things
Living near the city but close to nature gives you the best of both worlds.
住在城市附近又靠近大自然，真是两全其美。
Part 3 比较两种选择时用来收尾。
I'm feeling a bit under the weather today.
委婉地说身体小恙，和天气无关。
With two jobs, I'm on the go from morning till night.
我打两份工，从早到晚忙个不停。
be on the go；也有“在路上、随时”的意思。
a person who likes to stay up late
I'm a night owl; I do my best work after ten at night.
我是个夜猫子，晚上十点以后效率最高。
反义 an early bird，Part 1 谈作息时间好用。
a person who gets up early
My dad is an early bird and goes jogging at six.
我爸爸起得早，六点就去慢跑。
The early bird catches the worm 早起的鸟儿有虫吃。
to watch or look after something or someone
Could you keep an eye on my bag while I buy a ticket?
我去买票的时候，你能帮我看一下包吗？
keep an eye on sb / sth，口语非常常用。
used to say that time passes very quickly
Time flies; I can't believe I've lived here for five years.
时间过得真快，真不敢相信我已经在这儿住了五年。
也说 Time flies when you're having fun。
every cloud has a silver lining
there is something good in every bad situation
I lost my job, but every cloud has a silver lining: I finally started my own business.
我丢了工作，但坏事也有好的一面：我终于开始自己创业了。
安慰别人或讲坏事变好事；也可以只说 a silver lining。
not the end of the world
Failing one test is not the end of the world.
一次考试没过，并不是什么大不了的事。
安慰别人或自己：It's not the end of the world。
压垮骆驼的最后一根稻草
the final problem that makes a situation impossible to accept
When the landlord raised the rent again, it was the last straw.
房东又涨房租，这成了压垮我的最后一根稻草。
讲为什么做出某个决定（搬家、辞职）。
it is better to do something late than not at all
I started learning English at forty, but better late than never.
我四十岁才开始学英语，不过晚学总比不学好。
谈晚开始的爱好、学习很自然。
Getting up at six every day is easier said than done.
每天六点起床，说起来容易做起来难。
回应建议时常用：That's easier said than done。
In a nutshell, I love my job but not the commute.
简而言之，我喜欢我的工作，但不喜欢通勤。
回答收尾时总结，比 in conclusion 口语。
on the tip of my tongue
The name of the restaurant is on the tip of my tongue.
那家餐馆的名字就在嘴边，可就是想不起来。
考试中想不起某个词时，可以用它自然地圆场。
His name rings a bell, but I can't remember where we met.
他的名字听着耳熟，但我想不起在哪儿见过。
主语是名字、地方：Does that ring a bell?
Our holiday plans are still up in the air.
我们的度假计划还没定下来。
谈未来计划时表示“还没定”。
